✦ IntelligencePipeline

Tutorial

Build a Voice AI Pipeline the Classic Way

Before on-device language models, a voice feature meant chaining separate frameworks: record audio, turn it into text, guess the intent, then send the question to a cloud model. Build that pipeline stage by stage, and see exactly what Apple Intelligence makes simpler.

Get started

Chapter 1

Audio In

Get a question into the app as audio, then into text, entirely on the device.

Tutorial 1 · 20 minCapturing AudioEvery voice feature starts with an audio file. Describe the pipeline's four stages, then create audio two ways: by speaking a sample question with text-to-speech, and by recording the microphone.Tutorial 2 · 25 minSpeech to TextTurn the audio file into text with Apple's Speech framework. Start with the long-standing SFSpeechRecognizer, then add iOS 26's SpeechAnalyzer, which runs fully on the device with its own downloadable model, and keep a fallback for devices that can't run it.

Chapter 2

Deciding and Answering

Decide on the device whether a request needs a large model, and if it does, call one in the cloud.

Tutorial 3 · 10 minRouting on the DeviceNot every request needs a large model. A small on-device router decides: commands like "turn on the lights" are handled locally, and only questions it can't handle go to the cloud. That saves cost and time, and keeps more of the user's words on the device.Tutorial 4 · 25 minCalling a Cloud LLMSend the question to a large model over HTTPS. Support three providers, keep API keys out of the code, and fall back to a labelled Demo mode when there's no key, so the demo still runs without a network.

Chapter 3

Wiring the Pipeline

Run the four stages in order, show each one live, and compare the result with Foundation Models.

Tutorial 5 · 25 minRunning the PipelineRun the four stages in order from one view model, show each stage's status as it happens, and choose the input. Then step back and compare the whole pipeline with what a single on-device LanguageModelSession does.

Tutorial 1 of 5 · 20 min

Capturing Audio

Every voice feature starts with an audio file. Describe the pipeline's four stages, then create audio two ways: by speaking a sample question with text-to-speech, and by recording the microphone.

Section 1

Describe the Stages

Create a new iOS App project named IntelligencePipeline with SwiftUI and iOS 26 as the deployment target. In the target's Info tab, add Privacy - Microphone Usage Description and Privacy - Speech Recognition Usage Description; iOS shows these when it asks for permission, and the app crashes without them.

  1. Step 1

    Create PipelineStage.swift with PipelineStep: the four stages in order, each with a title and an SF Symbol.

    PipelineStage.swift
    1// PipelineStage.swift2// Defines the stages of the intelligence pipeline and their state.3 4import Foundation5 6/// The four stages of the pipeline.7enum PipelineStep: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable {8    case record, transcribe, classifyIntent, cloudLLM9 10    var id: Int { rawValue }11 12    var title: String {13        switch self {14        case .record:          return "Record"15        case .transcribe:      return "Transcribe"16        case .classifyIntent:  return "Classify Intent"17        case .cloudLLM:        return "Cloud LLM"18        }19    }20 21    var systemImage: String {22        switch self {23        case .record:          return "mic.fill"24        case .transcribe:      return "text.bubble.fill"25        case .classifyIntent:  return "brain.filled.head.profile"26        case .cloudLLM:        return "icloud.and.arrow.up.fill"27        }28    }29}

  2. Step 2

    Add StageStatus. A stage is waiting, running, done with an output, or failed with a message. The screen will show each stage's status live, which is the point of this demo: you see the hand-off between frameworks.

    PipelineStage.swift
    ⋯1// PipelineStage.swift2// Defines the stages of the intelligence pipeline and their state.3 4import Foundation5 6/// The four stages of the pipeline.7enum PipelineStep: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable {8    case record, transcribe, classifyIntent, cloudLLM9 10    var id: Int { rawValue }11 12    var title: String {13        switch self {14        case .record:          return "Record"15        case .transcribe:      return "Transcribe"16        case .classifyIntent:  return "Classify Intent"17        case .cloudLLM:        return "Cloud LLM"18        }19    }20 21    var systemImage: String {22        switch self {23        case .record:          return "mic.fill"24        case .transcribe:      return "text.bubble.fill"25        case .classifyIntent:  return "brain.filled.head.profile"26        case .cloudLLM:        return "icloud.and.arrow.up.fill"27        }28    }29}30 31/// The status of a single pipeline stage.32enum StageStatus: Equatable {33    case waiting, running, done(String), failed(String)34 35    var isDone: Bool {36        if case .done = self { return true }37        return false38    }39 40    var output: String? {41        if case .done(let s) = self { return s }42        return nil43    }44}

Section 2

Speak the Sample

A live demo shouldn't depend on a bundled recording or a quiet room. The app generates its sample question itself: AVSpeechSynthesizer can write speech to buffers instead of the speaker.

  1. Step 1

    Create SampleAudioService.swift. The file name includes a hash of the text, so changing sampleText produces a fresh file, and an existing file is reused.

    SampleAudioService.swift
    1// SampleAudioService.swift2// Creates the sample audio on the device, so the project needs no bundled recording.3// AVSpeechSynthesizer speaks the question into a file instead of the speaker;4// the pipeline then transcribes that file like any other recording.5 6import AVFoundation7import Foundation8 9final class SampleAudioService: NSObject {10 11    /// The question the demo speaks. Change it and the sample is regenerated on the next run.12    static let sampleText = "What is the weather going to be like in Jakarta tomorrow?"13 14    private let synthesizer = AVSpeechSynthesizer()15 16    /// Where the generated file lives. The file name includes a hash of the text,17    /// so changing `sampleText` produces a new file.18    var sampleURL: URL {19        let name = "sample-\(abs(Self.sampleText.hashValue)).caf"20        return FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(name)21    }22 23    /// Returns a file containing the spoken sample, generating it on first use.24    func sampleAudio() async throws -> URL {25        let url = sampleURL26        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) { return url }27        // Speaking the text into the file: next step28        return url29    }30}31 32enum SampleAudioError: LocalizedError {33    case noAudioProduced34    var errorDescription: String? {35        "The speech synthesizer produced no audio. Check that a voice is installed in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content."36    }37}

  2. Step 2

    Add synthesize(_:to:). synthesizer.write(_:) calls back with audio buffers; the first one creates an AVAudioFile in the same format, each buffer is appended, and an empty buffer means the speech has finished. A checked continuation turns the callbacks into one await.

    SampleAudioService.swift
    ⋯1// SampleAudioService.swift2// Creates the sample audio on the device, so the project needs no bundled recording.3// AVSpeechSynthesizer speaks the question into a file instead of the speaker;4// the pipeline then transcribes that file like any other recording.5 6import AVFoundation7import Foundation8 9final class SampleAudioService: NSObject {10 11    /// The question the demo speaks. Change it and the sample is regenerated on the next run.12    static let sampleText = "What is the weather going to be like in Jakarta tomorrow?"13 14    private let synthesizer = AVSpeechSynthesizer()15 16    /// Where the generated file lives. The file name includes a hash of the text,17    /// so changing `sampleText` produces a new file.18    var sampleURL: URL {19        let name = "sample-\(abs(Self.sampleText.hashValue)).caf"20        return FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(name)21    }22 23    /// Returns a file containing the spoken sample, generating it on first use.24    func sampleAudio() async throws -> URL {25        let url = sampleURL26        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) { return url }27        try await synthesize(Self.sampleText, to: url)28        return url29    }30 31    /// Speaks `text` into a CAF file at `url`.32    private func synthesize(_ text: String, to url: URL) async throws {33        let utterance = AVSpeechUtterance(string: text)34        utterance.voice = AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: "en-AU") ?? AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: "en-US")35        utterance.rate = AVSpeechUtteranceDefaultSpeechRate36 37        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)38        var file: AVAudioFile?39        var writeError: Error?40 41        try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Error>) in42            var finished = false43            synthesizer.write(utterance) { buffer in44                guard !finished else { return }45                guard let pcm = buffer as? AVAudioPCMBuffer else { return }46                if pcm.frameLength == 0 {47                    // An empty buffer marks the end of speech.48                    finished = true49                    if let writeError { continuation.resume(throwing: writeError) }50                    else if file == nil { continuation.resume(throwing: SampleAudioError.noAudioProduced) }51                    else { continuation.resume() }52                    return53                }54                do {55                    if file == nil {56                        file = try AVAudioFile(forWriting: url,57                                               settings: pcm.format.settings,58                                               commonFormat: pcm.format.commonFormat,59                                               interleaved: pcm.format.isInterleaved)60                    }61                    try file?.write(from: pcm)62                } catch {63                    writeError = error64                }65            }66        }67        file = nil // closes the file68    }69}70 ⋯71enum SampleAudioError: LocalizedError {72    case noAudioProduced73    var errorDescription: String? {74        "The speech synthesizer produced no audio. Check that a voice is installed in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content."75    }76}

Section 3

Record the Microphone

AVAudioEngine records in the microphone's own format, which is the most reliable choice: no compression step that could fail, and the file feeds straight into speech recognition.

  1. Step 1

    Create AudioRecorderService.swift. start() sets the audio session to .record, installs a tap on the input node and writes every buffer to a file. stop() removes the tap and closes the file so it can be read. If the input format has no channels, there's no microphone, so it says so instead of recording silence.

    AudioRecorderService.swift
    1// AudioRecorderService.swift2// Records the microphone with AVAudioEngine, writing the mic's own format to a .caf file.3// It also reports a live level (0…1) so the UI can show the mic is hearing you.4 5import AVFoundation6import Foundation7 8final class AudioRecorderService {9 10    private let engine = AVAudioEngine()11    private var file: AVAudioFile?12    private var sampleRate: Double = 013    private(set) var fileURL: URL?14    private(set) var framesWritten: AVAudioFramePosition = 015    private(set) var isRecording = false16 17    /// Seconds recorded so far.18    var recordedSeconds: Double { sampleRate > 0 ? Double(framesWritten) / sampleRate : 0 }19 20    /// Asks for microphone access. Returns false if it was refused now or earlier.21    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {22        await AVAudioApplication.requestRecordPermission()23    }24 25    func start() throws {26        let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()27        try session.setCategory(.record, mode: .default)28        try session.setActive(true)29 30        let input = engine.inputNode31        let format = input.outputFormat(forBus: 0)32        guard format.sampleRate > 0, format.channelCount > 0 else { throw RecorderError.noMicrophone }33 34        let url = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("recording.caf")35        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)36        file = try AVAudioFile(forWriting: url, settings: format.settings,37                               commonFormat: format.commonFormat, interleaved: format.isInterleaved)38        sampleRate = format.sampleRate39        framesWritten = 040 41        input.removeTap(onBus: 0)42        input.installTap(onBus: 0, bufferSize: 4096, format: format) { [weak self] buffer, _ in43            guard let self else { return }44            do {45                try self.file?.write(from: buffer)46                self.framesWritten += AVAudioFramePosition(buffer.frameLength)47            } catch {48                // Keep recording; a dropped buffer only loses a fraction of a second.49            }50        }51 52        engine.prepare()53        do {54            try engine.start()55        } catch {56            input.removeTap(onBus: 0)57            file = nil58            throw RecorderError.couldNotStart(error.localizedDescription)59        }60        fileURL = url61        isRecording = true62    }63 64    /// Stops recording and returns the file.65    func stop() -> URL? {66        guard isRecording else { return fileURL }67        engine.inputNode.removeTap(onBus: 0)68        engine.stop()69        file = nil   // closes the file so it can be read70        isRecording = false71        try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(false, options: .notifyOthersOnDeactivation)72        return fileURL73    }74}75 76enum RecorderError: LocalizedError {77    case noMicrophone78    case couldNotStart(String)79 80    var errorDescription: String? {81        switch self {82        case .noMicrophone:83            return "No microphone input is available. On the simulator, choose a Mac microphone in I/O › Audio Input."84        case .couldNotStart(let reason):85            return "The microphone couldn’t start: \(reason) Is another app using it?"86        }87    }88}

  2. Step 2

    Add a live level. Each buffer's root-mean-square loudness is mapped to 0…1 and passed to onLevel. The screen will show it as a moving bar: if it doesn't move when you speak, you know the problem is the microphone, not speech recognition.

    AudioRecorderService.swift

Double(framesWritten) / sampleRate : 0 }⋯22 23    /// Asks for microphone access. Returns false if it was refused now or earlier.24    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {25        await AVAudioApplication.requestRecordPermission()26    }27 28    func start() throws {29        let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()30        try session.setCategory(.record, mode: .default)31        try session.setActive(true)32 33        let input = engine.inputNode34        let format = input.outputFormat(forBus: 0)35        guard format.sampleRate > 0, format.channelCount > 0 else { throw RecorderError.noMicrophone }36 37        let url = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("recording.caf")38        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)39        file = try AVAudioFile(forWriting: url, settings: format.settings,40                               commonFormat: format.commonFormat, interleaved: format.isInterleaved)41        sampleRate = format.sampleRate42        framesWritten = 043 44        input.removeTap(onBus: 0)45        input.installTap(onBus: 0, bufferSize: 4096, format: format) { [weak self] buffer, _ in46            guard let self else { return }47            do {48                try self.file?.write(from: buffer)49                self.framesWritten += AVAudioFramePosition(buffer.frameLength)50            } catch {51                // Keep recording; a dropped buffer only loses a fraction of a second.52            }53            self.onLevel?(Self.level(of: buffer))54        }55 56        engine.prepare()⋯57        do {58            try engine.start()59        } catch {60            input.removeTap(onBus: 0)61            file = nil62            throw RecorderError.couldNotStart(error.localizedDescription)63        }64        fileURL = url65        isRecording = true66    }67 68    /// Stops recording and returns the file.69    func stop() -> URL? {70        guard isRecording else { return fileURL }71        engine.inputNode.removeTap(onBus: 0)72        engine.stop()73        file = nil   // closes the file so it can be read74        isRecording = false75        onLevel?(0)76        try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(false, options: .notifyOthersOnDeactivation)77        return fileURL78    }79 80    /// Root-mean-square loudness of the first channel, mapped from -50…0 dB to 0…1.81    private static func level(of buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) -> Float {82        guard let samples = buffer.floatChannelData?[0], buffer.frameLength > 0 else { return 0 }83        var sum: Float = 084        for i in 0..<Int(buffer.frameLength) { sum += samples[i] * samples[i] }85        let rms = (sum / Float(buffer.frameLength)).squareRoot()86        let db = 20 * log10(max(rms, 0.000_01))87        return max(0, min(1, (db + 50) / 50))88    }89}90 ⋯91enum RecorderError: LocalizedError {92    case noMicrophone93    case couldNotStart(String)94 95    var errorDescription: String? {96        switch self {97        case .noMicrophone:98            return "No microphone input is available. On the simulator, choose a Mac microphone in I/O › Audio Input."99        case .couldNotStart(let reason):100            return "The microphone couldn’t start: \(reason) Is another app using it?"101        }102    }103}

Speech to Text

Turn the audio file into text with Apple's Speech framework. Start with the long-standing SFSpeechRecognizer, then add iOS 26's SpeechAnalyzer, which runs fully on the device with its own downloadable model, and keep a fallback for devices that can't run it.

Download Project Files

Section 1

Start with SFSpeechRecognizer

SFSpeechRecognizer has been around since iOS 10. It relies on the device's Dictation service, so it needs Dictation turned on, and on a simulator it often can't start at all.

  1. Step 1

    Create SpeechTranscriberService.swift. requestPermission() asks for speech recognition access. transcribe(audioURL:) tries Australian, US and British English in turn and collects every failure, so the final error lists what went wrong for each. lastEngine records which engine succeeded.

    SpeechTranscriberService.swift
    1// SpeechTranscriberService.swift2// Turns an audio file into text, trying three engines in turn:3//   1. SpeechTranscriber (iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer): on-device, newest model, not on every iPhone.4//   2. DictationTranscriber (iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer): on-device, works on more devices.5//   3. SFSpeechRecognizer: the older API. Needs Dictation turned on in Settings.6// `lastEngine` says which one produced the text, so the UI can show it.7 8import Foundation9import Speech10import AVFoundation11 12class SpeechTranscriberService {13 14    private(set) var lastEngine = ""15 16    // MARK: – Permission17    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {18        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in19            SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization { status in20                continuation.resume(returning: status == .authorized)21            }22        }23    }24 25    // MARK: – Transcription from file26    func transcribe(audioURL: URL) async throws -> String {27        var problems: [String] = []28        if let file = try? AVAudioFile(forReading: audioURL) {29            let f = file.processingFormat30            print("[Speech] Transcribing \(audioURL.lastPathComponent): \(String(format: "%.1f", Double(file.length) / f.sampleRate)) s, \(Int(f.sampleRate)) Hz, \(f.channelCount) ch")31        }32 33        for locale in ["en-AU", "en-US", "en-GB"] {34            do {35                let text = try await transcribeWithLegacyRecognizer(audioURL, locale: Locale(identifier: locale))36                lastEngine = "SFSpeechRecognizer (\(locale))"37                return text38            } catch {39                problems.append("SFSpeechRecognizer \(locale): \(error.localizedDescription)")40                print("[Speech] SFSpeechRecognizer \(locale) failed: \(error)")41            }42        }43        throw TranscriptionError.allFailed(problems)44    }45 46    // MARK: – Fallback: SFSpeechRecognizer47    private func transcribeWithLegacyRecognizer(_ url: URL, locale: Locale) async throws -> String {48        guard let recognizer = SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: locale), recognizer.isAvailable else {49            throw TranscriptionError.recognizerUnavailable50        }51        let request = SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest(url: url)52        request.shouldReportPartialResults = false53        request.taskHint = .dictation54        request.requiresOnDeviceRecognition = recognizer.supportsOnDeviceRecognition55 56        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in57            var finished = false58            recognizer.recognitionTask(with: request) { result, error in59                guard !finished else { return }60                if let error {61                    finished = true62                    continuation.resume(throwing: error)63                    return64                }65                guard let result, result.isFinal else { return }66                finished = true67                continuation.resume(returning: result.bestTranscription.formattedString)68            }69        }70    }71}72 73enum TranscriptionError: LocalizedError {74    case recognizerUnavailable75    case nothingHeard76    case noEnglishModel([String])77    case noAudioFormat78    case allFailed([String])79 80    var errorDescription: String? {81        switch self {82        case .recognizerUnavailable:83            return "Speech recognizer is not available for this locale."84        case .nothingHeard:85            return "No speech was recognised in the audio."86        case .noEnglishModel(let locales):87            return "No English speech model is offered. Available: \(locales.prefix(8).joined(separator: ", "))."88        case .noAudioFormat:89            return "The audio couldn’t be converted for the speech analyzer."90        case .allFailed(let problems):91            return "Speech recognition failed.\n" + problems.map { "• " + $0 }.joined(separator: "\n")92                + "\nOn iPhone, check Settings › General › Keyboard › Enable Dictation is on."93        }94    }95}

Section 2

Add SpeechAnalyzer

SpeechAnalyzer (iOS 26) runs modules such as SpeechTranscriber on the device. It needs four things done in order, and skipping one gives errors like "Cannot use modules with unallocated locales".

  1. Step 1

    Add the SpeechAnalyzer path and try it first. pickEnglish chooses from the locales the module supports. prepare reserves the locale and downloads its model if needed. analyze streams the audio through an AsyncStream<AnalyzerInput>, converted by feedAudio to the analyzer's best format one second at a time, while a separate task collects the final results.

    SpeechTranscriberService.swift
    ⋯1// SpeechTranscriberService.swift2// Turns an audio file into text, trying three engines in turn:3//   1. SpeechTranscriber (iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer): on-device, newest model, not on every iPhone.4//   2. DictationTranscriber (iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer): on-device, works on more devices.5//   3. SFSpeechRecognizer: the older API. Needs Dictation turned on in Settings.6// `lastEngine` says which one produced the text, so the UI can show it.7 8import Foundation9import Speech10import AVFoundation11 12class SpeechTranscriberService {13 14    private(set) var lastEngine = ""15 16    // MARK: – Permission17    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {18        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in19            SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization { status in20                continuation.resume(returning: status == .authorized)21            }22        }23    }24 25    // MARK: – Transcription from file26    func transcribe(audioURL: URL) async throws -> String {27        var problems: [String] = []28        if let file = try? AVAudioFile(forReading: audioURL) {29            let f = file.processingFormat30            print("[Speech] Transcribing \(audioURL.lastPathComponent): \(String(format: "%.1f", Double(file.length) / f.sampleRate)) s, \(Int(f.sampleRate)) Hz, \(f.channelCount) ch")31        }32 33        if SpeechTranscriber.isAvailable {34            do {35                let text = try await transcribeWithSpeechTranscriber(audioURL)36                lastEngine = "SpeechTranscriber"37                return text38            } catch {39                problems.append("SpeechTranscriber: \(error.localizedDescription)")40                print("[Speech] SpeechTranscriber failed: \(error)")41            }42        } else {43            problems.append("SpeechTranscriber: not supported on this device")44            print("[Speech] SpeechTranscriber is not available on this device")45        }46 47        for locale in ["en-AU", "en-US", "en-GB"] {48            do {49                let text = try await transcribeWithLegacyRecognizer(audioURL, locale: Locale(identifier: locale))⋯50                lastEngine = "SFSpeechRecognizer (\(locale))"51                return text52            } catch {53                problems.append("SFSpeechRecognizer \(locale): \(error.localizedDescription)")54                print("[Speech] SFSpeechRecognizer \(locale) failed: \(error)")55            }56        }57        throw TranscriptionError.allFailed(problems)58    }59 60    // MARK: – SpeechAnalyzer engines61 62    private func transcribeWithSpeechTranscriber(_ url: URL) async throws -> String {63        let locale = try pickEnglish(from: await SpeechTranscriber.supportedLocales)64        let transcriber = SpeechTranscriber(locale: locale,65                                            transcriptionOptions: [],66                                            reportingOptions: [],67                                            attributeOptions: [])68        try await prepare(locale: locale, modules: [transcriber])69        let collector = Task {70            var text = ""71            for try await result in transcriber.results where result.isFinal {72                text += Australian, then US, then any English.80    private func pickEnglish(from supported: [Locale]) throws -> Locale {81        let english = supported.filter { $0.language.languageCode?.identifier == "en" }82        if let locale = english.first(where: { $0.region?.identifier == "AU" })83            ?? english.first(where: { $0.region?.identifier == "US" })84            ?? english.first {85 needed.91    private func prepare(locale: Locale, modules: [any SpeechModule]) async throws {92        let reserved = await AssetInventory.reservedLocales93        if !reserved.contains(where: { $0.identifier(.bcp47) == locale.identifier(.bcp47) }) {94            _ = try await AssetInventory.reserve(locale: locale)95        }96        if let request = try await AssetInventory.assetInstallationRequest(supporting: modules) {97            try await request.downloadAndInstall()98        }99    }100 101    /// Streams the file through a SpeechAnalyzer and returns what `collector` gathered.102    private func analyze(_ url: URL, modules: [any SpeechModule], collector: Task<String, Error>) async throws -> String {103        defer { collector.cancel() }104        guard let format = await SpeechAnalyzer.bestAvailableAudioFormat(compatibleWith: modules) else {105            throw TranscriptionError.noAudioFormat106        }107        let analyzer = SpeechAnalyzer(modules: modules)108        let (inputSequence, inputBuilder) = AsyncStream<AnalyzerInput>.makeStream()109        try await analyzer.start(inputSequence: inputSequence)110        try feedAudio(from: url, as: format, into: inputBuilder)111        inputBuilder.finish()112        try await analyzer.finalizeAndFinishThroughEndOfInput()113 114        let text = try await collector.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)115        guard !text.isEmpty else { throw TranscriptionError.nothingHeard }116        return text117    }118 119    /// Reads the file and converts it to `format`, yielding one buffer per second of audio.120    private func feedAudio(from url: URL, as format: AVAudioFormat, into builder: AsyncStream<AnalyzerInput>.Continuation) throws {121        let file = try AVAudioFile(forReading: url)122        let inFormat = file.processingFormat123        guard let converter = AVAudioConverter(from: inFormat, to: format) else {124 inBuffer = AVAudioPCMBuffer(pcmFormat: inFormat, frameCapacity: chunk) else { break }129            try file.read(into: inBuffer, frameCount: chunk)130            if inBuffer.frameLength == 0 { break }131 132            let ratio = format.sampleRate / inFormat.sampleRate133            let capacity = AVAudioFrameCount(Double(inBuffer.frameLength) * ratio) + 1024134            guard let outBuffer = AVAudioPCMBuffer(pcmFormat: format, frameCapacity: capacity) else { break }135 136            var handedOver = false137            var conversionError: NSError?138            converter.convert(to: outBuffer, error: &conversionError) { _, status in139                if handedOver { status.pointee = .noDataNow; return nil }140                handedOver = true141                status.pointee = .haveData142                return inBuffer143            }144            if let conversionError { throw conversionError }145            if outBuffer.frameLength > 0 { Section 3

Fall Back to Dictation

SpeechTranscriber isn't available on every iPhone. DictationTranscriber is a second SpeechAnalyzer module that works on more devices, and because it uses the same prepare and analyze helpers, adding it is short.

  1. Step 1

    Add transcribeWithDictationTranscriber and try it between the other two. The chain is now newest model, then wider compatibility, then the older API.

AVAudioFile(forReading: url)145        let inFormat = file.processingFormat146        guard let converter = AVAudioConverter(from: inFormat, to: format) else {147            throw Up nextRouting on the Device

Tutorial 3 of 5 · 10 min

Routing on the Device

Not every request needs a large model. A small on-device router decides: commands like "turn on the lights" are handled locally, and only questions it can't handle go to the cloud. That saves cost and time, and keeps more of the user's words on the device.

Download Project Files

Section 1

Classify the Intent

The router returns a label and a confidence. The rule for going to the cloud lives with the result, so it's easy to find and change.

  1. Step 1

    Create IntentResult.swift. requiresCloud is true for questions, and for anything the router is less than 75% sure about.

    IntentResult.swift
    1// IntentResult.swift2// Models the output of the NaturalLanguage intent classifier.3 4import Foundation5 6/// A classified intent from user speech.7struct IntentResult {8    let label: String       // e.g. "question", "command", "greeting"9    let confidence: Double  // 0.0 – 1.010 11    var requiresCloud: Bool {12        // Route to cloud if label is "question" or confidence is low13        return label == "question" || confidence < 0.7514    }15}

  2. Step 2

    Create IntentClassifierService.swift. Keywords catch questions and commands; anything else falls back to NaturalLanguage's sentiment score, which turns into a statement with a lower confidence. The TODO shows how a Create ML text classifier would replace the keywords.

    IntentClassifierService.swift
    1// IntentClassifierService.swift2// Uses NaturalLanguage framework to classify the intent of a text string.3// Students can swap in a Create ML NLModel for a custom domain classifier.4 5import Foundation6import NaturalLanguage7 8class IntentClassifierService {9 10    // MARK: – Built-in sentiment tagger (Course 1 recap)11    private let sentimentTagger = NLTagger(tagSchemes: [.sentimentScore])12 13    // MARK: – Intent classification14    /// Classify the intent of `text` into a simple label + confidence.15    func classifyIntent(text: String) -> IntentResult {16 17        // ── Keyword-based intent router (simple baseline) ──────────────18        // TODO (students): Replace with a trained NLModel from Create ML19        //   let model = try? NLModel(mlModel: MyIntentClassifier().model)20        //   return IntentResult(label: model?.predictedLabel(for: text) ?? "unknown",21        //                       confidence: model?.predictedLabelHypotheses(for: text, maximumCount: 1).values.first ?? 0)22 23        let lower = text.lowercased()24        if lower.contains("?") || lower.hasPrefix("what") || lower.hasPrefix("how") ||25           lower.hasPrefix("who") || lower.hasPrefix("when") || lower.hasPrefix("why") {26            return IntentResult(label: "question", confidence: 0.85)27        } else if lower.hasPrefix("set") || lower.hasPrefix("open") ||28                  lower.hasPrefix("turn") || lower.hasPrefix("call") {29            return IntentResult(label: "command", confidence: 0.88)30        } else {31            // Fallback: use sentiment to guess32            sentimentTagger.string = text33            let (sentiment, _) = sentimentTagger.tag(at: text.startIndex,34                                                     unit: .paragraph,35                                                     scheme: .sentimentScore)36            let score = Double(sentiment?.rawValue ?? "0") ?? 037            return IntentResult(label: score >= 0 ? "positive_statement" : "negative_statement",38                                confidence: 0.60 + abs(score) * 0.3)39        }40    }41}

Up nextCalling a Cloud LLM

Tutorial 4 of 5 · 25 min

Calling a Cloud LLM

Send the question to a large model over HTTPS. Support three providers, keep API keys out of the code, and fall back to a labelled Demo mode when there's no key, so the demo still runs without a network.

Download Project Files

Section 1

Choose a Provider and Store the Key

An API key in source code ends up on GitHub sooner or later. Store it in the Keychain, entered by the user at run time; the provider and model are ordinary preferences.

  1. Step 1

    Create LLMSettings.swift with LLMProvider: a title, a sensible inexpensive default model, and where to get a key. Model names change over time, which is why the default can be overridden.

    LLMSettings.swift
    1// LLMSettings.swift2// Which cloud provider to call, which model, and the API key (kept in the Keychain).3// Nothing here is hard-coded into the app, so the project can be shared safely.4 5import Foundation6import Security7 8/// The cloud LLM providers the pipeline can call.9enum LLMProvider: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {10    case openAI, gemini, anthropic11 12    var id: String { rawValue }13 14    var title: String {15        switch self {16        case .openAI:    return "OpenAI"17        case .gemini:    return "Google Gemini"18        case .anthropic: return "Anthropic"19        }20    }21 22    /// A sensible, inexpensive default model. Editable in Settings.23    var defaultModel: String {24        switch self {25        case .openAI:    return "gpt-4o-mini"26        case .gemini:    return "gemini-2.5-flash"27        case .anthropic: return "claude-haiku-5-5"28        }29    }30 31    var keyHelp: String {32        switch self {33        case .openAI:    return "platform.openai.com › API keys. Keys start with sk-"34        case .gemini:    return "aistudio.google.com › Get API key. Keys start with AIza"35        case .anthropic: return "console.anthropic.com › API keys. Keys start with sk-ant-"36        }37    }38}

Provider and model go in UserDefaults; the key goes in the Keychain.41enum LLMSettings {42    private static let providerKey = "llm.provider"43    private static let modelKey = "llm.model."44 45    static var provider: LLMProvider {46        get { LLMProvider(rawValue: UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: providerKey) ?? "") ?? .openAI }47        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue.rawValue, forKey: providerKey) }48    }49 50    static func model(for provider: LLMProvider) -> String {51        let saved = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: modelKey + provider.rawValue) ?? ""52        return saved.isEmpty ? provider.defaultModel : saved53    }54 55    static func setModel(_ model: String, for provider: LLMProvider) {56        UserDefaults.standard.set(model, forKey: modelKey + provider.rawValue)57    }58 59    static func apiKey(for provider: LLMProvider) -> String? {60        Keychain.read(account: provider.rawValue)61    }62 63    static func setAPIKey(_ key: String, for provider: LLMProvider) {64        let trimmed = key.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)65        if trimmed.isEmpty { Keychain.delete(account: provider.rawValue) }66        else { Keychain.save(trimmed, account: provider.rawValue) }67    }68 69    /// True when the selected provider has a key, so the real API will be called.70    static var isConfigured: Bool {71        !(apiKey(for: provider) ?? "").isEmpty72    }73}74 75/// A tiny Keychain wrapper: one string per account.76private enum Keychain {77    private static let service = "au.edu.uts.IntelligencePipeline.apiKeys"78 79    private static func query(_ account: String) -> [String: Any] {80        [kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,81         kSecAttrService as String: service,82         kSecAttrAccount as String: account]83    }84 85    static func save(_ value: String, account: String) {86        let data = Data(value.utf8)87        var q = query(account)88        if SecItemCopyMatching(q as CFDictionary, nil) == errSecSuccess {89            SecItemUpdate(q as CFDictionary, [kSecValueData as String: data] as CFDictionary)90        } else {91            q[kSecValueData as String] = data92            SecItemAdd(q as CFDictionary, nil)93        }94    }95 96    static func read(account: String) -> String? {97        var q = query(account)98        q[kSecReturnData as String] = true99        q[kSecMatchLimit as String] = kSecMatchLimitOne100        var result: AnyObject?101        guard SecItemCopyMatching(q as CFDictionary, &result) == errSecSuccess,102              let data = result as? Data else { return nil }103        return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)104    }105 106    static func delete(account: String) {107        SecItemDelete(query(account) as CFDictionary)108    }109}

Section 2

Send the Request

Every provider wants the same thing, a prompt in and text out, but in a different shape: a different endpoint, auth header, body and reply path. That's the integration cost on-device models remove.

  1. Step 1

    Create CloudLLMService.swift with Demo mode first: no key means a short pause and a canned answer, clearly marked [Demo mode].

    CloudLLMService.swift
    1// CloudLLMService.swift2// Calls a cloud LLM over HTTPS: the "old way", before on-device Apple Intelligence.3// The provider, model and API key come from Settings. With no key, a Demo mode answers instead.4 5import Foundation6 7class CloudLLMService {8 9    /// Sends `prompt` to the selected provider and returns the reply text.10    func complete(prompt: String) async throws -> String {11        let provider = LLMSettings.provider12        guard let apiKey = LLMSettings.apiKey(for: provider), !apiKey.isEmpty else {13            try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))   // pretend to make a network call14            return demoResponse(for: prompt)15        }16        throw LLMError.invalidResponse   // The real request comes in the next step.17    }18 19    // MARK: – Demo mode20 21    private func demoResponse(for prompt: String) -> String {22        let lower = prompt.lowercased()23        if lower.contains("weather") {24            return "[Demo mode] Tomorrow in Jakarta expect around 31 °C with a chance of afternoon thunderstorms. Add an API key in Settings to get a real answer."25        }26        return "[Demo mode] A cloud model would answer “\(prompt.prefix(60))” here. Add an API key in Settings to call a real one."27    }28}29 30enum LLMError: LocalizedError {31    case invalidResponse32    case http(status: Int, body: String)33 34    var errorDescription: String? {35        switch self {36        case .invalidResponse:37            return "The cloud LLM returned a reply in an unexpected format."38        case .http(let status, let body):39            let hint: String40            switch status {41            case 401, 403: hint = "The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings."42            case 404:      hint = "The model name wasn’t found. Check it in Settings."43            case 429:      hint = "Rate limit or no credit left on this key."44            default:       hint = ""45            }46            return ["HTTP \(status).", hint, body].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: " ")47        }48    }49}

  2. Step 2

    Add the real call. makeRequest builds each provider's request, extractText digs the reply out of each JSON shape, and serverMessage turns an error reply into a readable message. HTTP 401, 404 and 429 get specific hints, and every call logs a [CloudLLM] line to the console.

    CloudLLMService.swift
    ⋯1// CloudLLMService.swift2// Calls a cloud LLM over HTTPS: the "old way", before on-device Apple Intelligence.3// The provider, model and API key come from Settings. With no key, a Demo mode answers instead.4 5import Foundation6 7class CloudLLMService {8 9    /// Sends `prompt` to the selected provider and returns the reply text.10    func complete(prompt: String) async throws -> String {11        let provider = LLMSettings.provider12        guard let apiKey = LLMSettings.apiKey(for: provider), !apiKey.isEmpty else {13            try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))   // pretend to make a network call14            return demoResponse(for: prompt)15        }16 17        let model = LLMSettings.model(for: provider)18        let request = try makeRequest(provider: provider, model: model, apiKey: apiKey, prompt: prompt)19        print("[CloudLLM] Calling \(provider.title) model \(model)…")20        let data: Data, response: URLResponse21        do {22            (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)23        } catch {24            print("[CloudLLM] Network error: \(error)")25            throw error26        }27 28        if let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse, !(200..<300).contains(http.statusCode) {29            let message = serverMessage(from: data)30            print("[CloudLLM] HTTP \(http.statusCode): \(message)")31            throw LLMError.http(status: http.statusCode, body: message)32        }33        print("[CloudLLM] OK")34        guard let text = extractText(provider: provider, data: data) else {35            throw LLMError.invalidResponse36        }37        return text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)38    }39 40    // MARK: – Building the request for each provider41 42    private func makeRequest(provider: LLMProvider, model: String, apiKey: String, prompt: String) throws -> URLRequest {43        let url: URL44        var headers = ["Content-Type": "application/json"]45        let body: [String: Any]46        let system = "Answer in two short sentences."47 48        switch provider {49        case .openAI:50            url = URL(string: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions")!51            headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer \(apiKey)"52            body = ["model": model,53                    "messages": [["role": "system", "content": system], ["role": "user", "content": prompt]],54                    "max_tokens": 200]55        case .gemini:56            url = URL(string: "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/\(model):generateContent")!57            headers["x-goog-api-key"] = apiKey58            body = ["system_instruction": ["parts": [["text": system]]],59                    "contents": [["parts": [["text": prompt]]]]]60        case .anthropic:61            url = URL(string: "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages")!62            headers["x-api-key"] = apiKey63            headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01"64            body = ["model": model, "max_tokens": 200, "system": system,65                    "messages": [["role": "user", "content": prompt]]]66        }67 68        var request = URLRequest(url: url)69        request.httpMethod = "POST"70        request.timeoutInterval = 3071        for (key, value) in headers { request.setValue(value, forHTTPHeaderField: key) }72        request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body)73        return request74    }75 76    // MARK: – Reading the reply from each provider's JSON shape77 78    private func extractText(provider: LLMProvider, data: Data) -> String? {79        guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else { return nil }80        switch provider {81        case .openAI:82            let choices = json["choices"] as? [[String: Any]]83            let message = choices?.first?["message"] as? [String: Any]84            return message?["content"] as? String85        case .gemini:86            let candidates = json["candidates"] as? [[String: Any]]87            let content = candidates?.first?["content"] as? [String: Any]88            let parts = content?["parts"] as? [[String: Any]]89            return parts?.compactMap { $0["text"] as? String }.joined()90        case .anthropic:91            let content = json["content"] as? [[String: Any]]92            return content?.compactMap { $0["text"] as? String }.joined()93        }94    }95 96    /// Pulls the human-readable message out of an error reply, whatever the provider.97    private func serverMessage(from data: Data) -> String {98        guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {99            return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)?.prefix(200).description ?? ""100        }101        if let error = json["error"] as? [String: Any], let message = error["message"] as? String { return message }102        if let error = json["error"] as? String { return error }103        return ""104    }105 106    // MARK: – Demo mode⋯107 108    private func demoResponse(for prompt: String) -> String {109        let lower = prompt.lowercased()110        if lower.contains("weather") {111            return "[Demo mode] Tomorrow in Jakarta expect around 31 °C with a chance of afternoon thunderstorms. Add an API key in Settings to get a real answer."112        }113        return "[Demo mode] A cloud model would answer “\(prompt.prefix(60))” here. Add an API key in Settings to call a real one."114    }115}116 117enum LLMError: LocalizedError {118    case invalidResponse119    case http(status: Int, body: String)120 121    var errorDescription: String? {122        switch self {123        case .invalidResponse:124            return "The cloud LLM returned a reply in an unexpected format."125        case .http(let status, let body):126            let hint: String127            switch status {128            case 401, 403: hint = "The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings."129            case 404:      hint = "The model name wasn’t found. Check it in Settings."130            case 429:      hint = "Rate limit or no credit left on this key."131            default:       hint = ""132            }133            return ["HTTP \(status).", hint, body].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: " ")134        }135    }136}

Section 3

Let Users Add a Key

A small form: pick a provider, optionally change the model, paste a key.

  1. Step 1

    Create SettingsView.swift. The key uses a SecureField, and the footer says whether the pipeline is live or in Demo mode. Switching provider loads that provider's saved model and key.

Running the Pipeline

Section 1

Orchestrate the Stages

PipelineViewModel owns the services and runs them one after another. Each stage sets its status before and after, so the screen animates through the pipeline.

  1. Step 1

    Create PipelineViewModel.swift with the input sources and run(audioURL:recordLabel:). Typed text skips transcription. If speech recognition fails on the sample, the known text is used and the stage says so honestly, so a demo never dead-ends. A failure anywhere else stops the pipeline with that stage's error.

Section 3

Then and Now

Run it and count the moving parts: four frameworks, three permissions, a hand-written router, three request formats, an API key and a network connection. With Foundation Models, one on-device session understands the request and returns typed output, and nothing leaves the device. That's what the rest of the course builds.

    Check that the app file shows ContentView, then run on an iPhone. Try Sample, record a question, and type "Turn on the living room lights" to watch the cloud stage be skipped.
